svg.title: Sri Lanka — Aram research map
svg.desc: All 25 districts, including the northern islands, projected from the same GADM boundaries as Aram’s research page. Purple highlights match that page’s active and planned districts as of 20 October 2026; they do not depict the prototype’s demo funding.
svg.metadata: Source: https://www.aram.org.uk/geo/gadm41_LKA_1.json | Research: https://www.aram.org.uk/research | GADM 4.1 boundaries | Retrieved 2026-10-20
